svg.title: Local Broadcast for Jellyfin
svg.desc: The plugin's settings page saves stations and teams; the sync service pushes them to the sidecar and registers the sidecar with Jellyfin Live TV as an M3U tuner and XMLTV guide. When Live TV asks for a channel, the sidecar's server has the resolver open the station's page in headless Chrome with media-scraper.js loaded first, finds the live stream, and proxies it back. For a station whose player is Anvato, anvato.js keeps the player's video ID from that first visit and afterwards asks Anvato's video API for the stream directly, with no browser. For local sports the sidecar reads team schedules from ESPN. setup: Settings page → SyncService → app.js, LiveTvRegistrar. a channel's first visit: Jellyfin Live TV → app.js → resolver.js → media-scraper.js, Station websites. an Anvato channel after that: Jellyfin Live TV → app.js → resolver.js → anvato.js → Anvato video API.
